newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade $67, brisk -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade $67, brisk -USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle on Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady with last test.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 25,600 slaughter steers and 16,100 heifers; 59,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,500 formulated and 700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
